text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa... gh.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah... that didn't work out, did it...?
choice_data_list:
You should hold back the pace more in the 
middle leg.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I understand it in my head, but... 
instinctively, it just makes me feel 
restless...
choice_data_list:
Then... how about focusing on saving your 
legs?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That might work. I'll give it a 
try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's medium-distance training 
was running into difficulties. 
Specifically, getting a grasp on race 
development.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You could say she's struggling precisely 
because she's an instinctual runner. The 
optimal way to run the mile has already 
become second nature to her body.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa! Yeah, that felt a mile 
better than before!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still... not nearly enough! Not if I want 
to beat Love-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan! Chrono-chan and Bouquet-san 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because Gran-chan left me a message in her 
entry announcement video for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we should declare our 
determination too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth, we were pretty 
depressed until around this spring."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't beat the older generation at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Still, seeing Gran-chan run gave me the 
strength to stand back up."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To think she could even defeat that Miss 
Eye...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
We can't just keep shrinking back in fear. 
I decided I had to find a path to 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I've become someone who can stand up to— 
and go toe-to-toe with—the older 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Searching for the path to victory... I 
have found it in the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The weight of the royal road... that, 
too, grants me strength..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You could say I went on a warrior's 
pilgrimage. I went and won in Hong Kong!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"In the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I won't let 
you conquer all three distance divisions!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh, eheheheh! 70 miles, I'm so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Together with everyone, we can forge the 
strongest generation. And the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) will be the day of our decisive 
battle—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I knew you would!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got to step up too— and take you 
on as the strongest Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Gran is having a really tough 
time out there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The order... for tandem running has been 
postponed. They say I have not yet... 
reached that level."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Me too. ...Well, that's what this is for, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Do I have the Trainer's... okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to," she said. I got Gran's 
reference materials.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Are you ready for the next rep, Taiki-san?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have caught my breath. I am 
alright!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —I'm on my way, Gran.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...You said today's training would be 
conducted in a race format, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even gotten the hang of middle 
distance yet, can I really put up a fight?
choice_data_list:
It's so I can get a feel for that 
"sensation."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You'll see when we get there.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Gran! Looking forward to working 
with you today!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki-senpai! ...Wait, so today's 
opponent is...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's me! But...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: At 2000m—it's Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: 1.25 miles?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Taiki's tuned up 
specifically for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Use our— running in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)—as reference.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki-san is a miler, after all. I 
thought her running style would be close 
to yours, Gran-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll have them experience Taiki Shuttle's 
running at medium distance while competing 
against her, learning it through pure 
'feel.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This method would be ideal for Gran 
Alegria to get a "feel" for middle 
distances.
choice_data_list:
So I'm going to have you run just like 
it's the real race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It might not be quite like running in my 
peak condition, but after plenty of 
training, I have finished preparing 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Please, absorb everything you can from me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh! Everyone, why would you go that 
far...!?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's because we share that same wish to 
pass the torch along, Gran.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Trainers made me realize 
something. Coaching is also just a 
constant cycle of trial and error, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to carry forward that 
effort— that history she staked her 
Trainer's life on?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's beneficial for us Umamusume 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...We want to connect it, too. Please, 
allow us to lend a hand."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――It was our own will.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now then, Gran. Are you ready, YES?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Gran & Taiki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...This might be the first time I've ever 
seen Gran-chan struggle like this. She 
usually picks things up so easily."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The wall of distance aptitude is really 
steep, huh. 1.25 miles wasn't anywhere 
close to a mile."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than the extra distance, the real 
bottleneck is how strong the rivals are. 
That's usually what stops people from 
sweeping all three tiers."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside Taiki Shuttle over 1.25 
miles to conquer medium distances was 
insanely hype!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
'I also felt the bond between Uma Musume 
and Trainer. I really want you to achieve 
the three-division conquest you inherited 
from your master!'

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing. Everyone's cheering for me to 
conquer all three divisions.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Fulfill your dream!" "Show us your grand 
finale!" I hear you loud and cleeeaar!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, my heart is full to the hundredth 
mile!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it makes you so happy, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If all these cheers turn into roars of 
victory, it's gonna be incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I sure wanna soak in those roaring cheers♪
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll get to soak in it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You think so?! Then I definitely have to 
win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The fans naturally began making their 
comments measured in units of miles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To them, 2000m is 1.25 miles. And when it 
comes to the mile, Gran Alegria is the 
undisputed strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was proof of the belief that she could 
win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the eyes of the fans, conquering three 
divisions changed from an impossibility to 
a tangible reality!
choice_data_list: (So I'm sure of it— Gran can win.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because the feelings of those who believe 
in her victory will push her forward in 
the form of cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If I close my eyes, that applause still 
rings vividly in the depths of my ears.
